title: RunUltra update — Smith and Turner win the 2026 Dragon's Back Race; field and finish counts
claims: Danny Smith led the six-day race from the opening stage and won in 46:59:52; Isobel Turner won the women's race in 67:46:19.
Of 210 starters from 20 nations, 53 completed the full course and another 63 finished the flexible Hatchling format.
2026 was the first edition run under Ultra X, which acquired the event after Ourea Events entered administration; entries for 2027 opened on 27 September.
